title: Detroit Murder Mystery: Self-Guided Detective Walk
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A body has been found in Detroit. Step into the role of detective and crack the case on this self-guided walking quest. Your smartphone delivers clues, witness statements, and puzzles as you navigate between real-world locations that become your crime scene.

Each stop reveals new evidence and suspects. Follow the trail from location to location, piecing together the story while exploring Detroit's streets. The app guides you step by step with an immersive narrative full of twists.

This 1–2 hour private detective adventure runs 24/7 — start whenever you want, pause for coffee or photos, and play at your own pace. Available in 5+ languages.
